verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Microsoft Graph API as a developer-facing REST endpoint with API references (e.g., user-list), which developers could build against, but there is no explicit mention of official SDKs (e.g., language-specific Graph SDKs, MSAL) or any AI-agentic-specific tooling. missing for 10: explicit SDK package documentation, language-specific SDK examples, agentic/AI-native use-case guidance.
